english.meaning: asks about the length of time
english.note: 做咗幾耐 means how long have you done it.

exampleSentences.english: How long? A minute? No way. It’s only a few laps of running.
exampleSentences.traditional: 幾耐啊？一分鐘？冇可能。跑步都係幾𡃉啫嗎。
